notes.title: Fugue of Delights – Coming July 23rd
notes.content:
Mark the date.
Fugue of Delights, the fifth chronicle in the Enygmage universe, will be released on July 23rd.
A deeper descent into the textures of desire, delirium, and dream.


Elylah returns — wounded, radiant, and relentless.
Vulpes burns. The daemonic dream fractures.
And you are not ready.

This new installment brings:

Refined artwork in chiaroscuro dreamscapes.

Tense erotic encounters and layered choices.

A descent into the heart of art, lust, and memory.

The fugue is a spiral.
You won’t know what you’ve lost until it ends.


Add to your wishlist now and be the first to descend.

The stage is set. The curtain trembles.
